name: idea-to-code
description: Self-assembling pipeline from a vague idea to working code: deep-interview clarifies, ralplan plans, autopilot executes (skipping already-completed phases via artifact detection)

stages.name: clarify
stages.description: Socratic deep interview to reduce ambiguity below threshold

stages.name: plan
stages.description: Consensus plan via Planner/Architect/Critic (uses --direct since spec already gathered)
stages.note: Invoked with --consensus --direct flags; ralplan aliases this stage

stages.name: execute
stages.description: Autopilot runs Phase 2+ (skips Phase 0+1 when consensus plan exists)
stages.note: Execution is approval-gated; deep-interview/plan must not auto-invoke autopilot
